 Canucks at Oilers projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 07, 2026 
 Link copied 
 CANUCKS (3-14-1) at OILERS (11-3-3) 
 10 p.m. ET; TVAS, SN 
 Canucks projected lineup 
 Arshdeep Bains -- Elias Pettersson -- Brock Boeser
 Liam Ohgren -- Marco Rossi -- Linus Karlsson
 Drew O'Connor -- Max Sasson -- Brendan Gallagher 
 Jake DeBrusk -- Paul Cotter -- Jonathan Lekkerimaki
 Elias Nils Pettersson -- Filip Hronek
 Jamie Oleksiak -- Zeev Buium
 Tom Willander -- Luke Schenn
 Leevi Merilainen
 Kevin Lankinen
 Scratched: Guillaume Brisebois, Victor Mancini, Jacob Quillan 
 Injured: Filip Chytil (upper body), Thatcher Demko (hip) 
 Oilers projected lineup 
 Vasily Podkolzin -- Connor McDavid -- Leon Draisaitl
 Kasperi Kapanen -- Ryan Nugent-Hopkins -- Zach Hyman
 Max Jones -- Jason Dickinson -- Mathieu Joseph
 Alex Formenton -- Owen Michaels -- Trent Frederic
 Mattias Ekholm -- Evan Bouchard
 Ryan Shea -- Connor Murphy
 Shakir Mukhamadullin -- Ty Emberson
 Devon Levi
 Tristan Jarry
 Scratched: Colton Dach, Filip Hallander, Jake Walman 
 Injured: Frederik Andersen (undisclosed), Isaac Howard (lower body), Mattias Janmark (undisclosed), Alec Regula (undisclosed), Matthew Savoie (undisclosed).  
 Status report 
 The Canucks held an optional morning skate. ... Bains is expected to enter the lineup for Quillan, a forward ... After missing two games with a lower-body injury, Willander is expected to replace Brisebois, a defenseman. ... Schenn is expected to come in for Mancini, a defenseman. ... Hyman returns after missing five games with a neck injury, replacing Dach, a forward, who wasn't on the ice for the morning skate. ... Frederic comes in for Hallander, a forward. ... Emberson replaces Walman. ... Levi will play after missing the past seven games with an undisclosed injury, while Jarry will dress after sitting out Edmonton's previous game due to illness. ... The Oilers assigned goalie Matt Tomkins to Bakersfield of the American Hockey League, while emergency backup goaltender Brett Epp was inactivated after dressing for one game. ... Defenseman Atro Leppanen was placed waivers for the purpose of being assigned to the AHL.
